title: 3BR Rosemary Beach Vacation Home with a Private Pool
meta_description: The newly redesigned home is conveniently located south of 30A near the Coquina Pool, Main Street & most importantly the beach! Abaco Pearl Cottage is the perfect choice for a Rosemary Beach getaway!
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guest Love• Private Pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)• 1 Minute Walk to Beach Walkover A or B• 4 Free Bikes Provided• Beach Towels IncludedHardwood and natural stone floors and neutral tones are accented with updated furnishings and amenities throughout this spacious and comfortable coastal abode conveniently located near the Coquina Pool, Main Street, and, of course, the white sand and emerald waters of South Walton’s world-famous beaches. An ideal beach retreat, the luxurious Abaco Pearl Cottage features a spectacular great room spanning the entire second floor, with comfortable lounge seating for seven, that's filled with natural light from the Florida sun. Poolside loungers and balconies with seating overlooking the front and back of the home make it the perfect setting for enjoying the outdoors in a serene setting.**The home's private pool was renovated in Winter 2024**The optimal location maximizes your walkability, allowing you to park the car and live on beach time for the duration of your stay, strolling or biking almost anywhere you could want to go. Should you decide to head out for a drive, you’ll find that you’re just minutes from all the iconic communities along Scenic Highway 30A. * Can also be rented with adjacent Abaco Pearl Carriage House that sleeps 5 (VRBO 664768)HOME LAYOUT: (2,076 square feet - Sleeps 8)FIRST FLOOR:• MASTER SUITE: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower/Tub Combo• MASTER SUITE: King Bed, Private Bath with Walk In Shower• GUEST BEDROOM: Twin Over Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bath with Stall Stand Up ShowerSECOND FLOOR: • Open Living Area with Ample Seating, Sleeper Sofa, and HDTV with Sonos Sound System• Kitchen with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances and breakfast bar with seating for 6• Dining Area With Seating for 8• Half Bath• Second Level Balcony off the back of the home with sofa sectional and chairs• Second Level Balcony off the front of the home with two rocking chairs and day bed porch swing• Laundry Room with Washer and DryerAMENITIES• Garage for One Car• Poolside lounge chairs• Natural Gas Grill (shared with carriage house)• Newly Upgraded Audio/Video with 65" Samsung Smart HDTV, Apple TV & Logitech All-in-One Remote, Sonos Sound System!• Clean Bedding ProgramCOMMUNITY AMENITIES:• 4 Community Pools (1 heated) 1 Minute Walk to Coquina Pool• 30 Second Walk to Playground Park• Spa offering a wide variety of services, including massage therapy, facials, nail services, and refreshing body treatments• Rosemary Beach Fitness Center with top-of-the-line Equipment and Certified Personal Training (use available for a fee)• Shopping• DiningSTR-025054 TDT-022754
